items.title: Oracle's $1.55 Million Grant Helps Trinity Community Commons Bring Its Neighborhood Vision to Life in Nashville
items.summary: Oracle today announced a $1.55 million grant to Trinity Community Commons (TCC) to renovate its community hub, a welcoming space for free community meals, neighborhood events, and connections to essential services. The grant supports the nonprofit's broader redevelopment of its historic East Nashville property, with groundbreaking to be announced soon.
